name: Fast flow, V0 = 4
setup: IC 2 with mean velocity V0 = 4, twice the largest training velocity (V0 in [1, 2]).
expect: Faster flow carries features through the domain quicker and the network extrapolates in velocity. Watch the troughs of h.
observed: The NN alone drifts badly: q error 9.5%, and its h troughs dip too low (1.71 vs DNS 1.94). MCL-NN stays close (q error 1.6%). One of the clearest cases for the limiter.
